name: Aim and Shoot
tagline: You aim. The robots learn. Don't touch the walls.
description:
You are the black one in the middle. Move, aim, shoot the robots before they shoot you. Each wave the survivors breed: they get better at dodging, better at hitting, better at not walking into the walls — which hurt you too.

On a computer, WASD or arrows to move, the mouse to aim, click to fire. On a phone a stick on the left moves you, a stick on the right aims, and the small circles fire. Tap the title art to start.

Your best generation lives in the file. Press Invite in the bar above and a friend sees how far you got — each of you plays your own arena.

An unofficial port of Aim and Shoot by Victor Ribeiro, a neuroevolution experiment. The bots, the gun, and the joke about Nole Ksum are his.
